units.source_text: 白居易《长恨歌》中有句云：“

en.t: In Bai Juyi's Song of Everlasting Sorrow, there are lines that say: "

units.source_text: 鸳鸯瓦冷霜华重，翡翠衾寒谁与共？”

en.t: The mandarin-duck tiles are cold and heavy with frost; the kingfisher quilt is chilled, and with whom can it be shared?"

units.source_text: 今作“旧枕故衾”，想是根据别本。

en.t: Here it is written as "old pillow and former quilt," probably based on another textual version.
